title: Collect every comment on a Douyin video with an agent
summary: A developer built a Claude Code skill that gathers a Douyin video's full comment thread; they report 195 of 195 comments in 138 seconds, matching a manual check.
agent_role: Claude Code, working in the user's logged-in Chrome, copies the page's own comment requests, pages through comments and replies, saves them and builds a report sorted by likes; the human pastes the link and solves any verification puzzle.
outcome: Author reports capturing 195 of 195 comments in 138 seconds and 135 of 135 on another video, with no verification prompts; on a 1,067-comment video it got 823.
what_they_did: Pluviobyte wrote a skill for Claude Code that uses the Chrome browser extension. You paste a Douyin video link and ask for its comments. The agent copies the page's real comment request, fetches all top comments and replies with pauses, then writes a single file sorted by likes.
how_it_went: The author reports 195 comments in 138 seconds on one video and 135 in 252 seconds on another. The first matched a manual click-through that took about 6 minutes.
worth_knowing: It stops if a verification puzzle appears and waits for you to solve it. On videos with over a thousand comments it misses some; the author says use it only for personal research.
prompt: In my logged-in Chrome, open this Douyin video: [video link]. Collect all top-level comments and every reply under them, pausing a few seconds between requests. If a verification puzzle appears, stop and wait for me to solve it. Save the raw data to [folder], then write one file listing comments sorted by likes with replies indented under each. Tell me how many you got versus the count the video shows.

curation.rationale: Clear, tested Claude Code skill with real numbers (195 comments in 138 seconds, matching a manual check) and honest limits; useful for creators and researchers outside coding.
